name: cut_list_counts_the_gussets_and_the_caps
why: D9 DEFECT 1, found on 6/10/2026 by the live proof of the prerequisites. `cut_list` read the cut-list items that are structural members and no others, so the gussets and the end caps of a weldment were never counted: the tube stand of task 07, 17 bodies and 6 distinct entries, read 9 bodies and 4 rows. A plausible number, wrong, and with no error: the worst kind. This case builds the smallest part that has the three kinds of item (two bars, a gusset in the corner between them, a cap at each free end of the long bar) and asks the cut list to count every body. It uses the T and the good gusset of gusset_sits_in_the_corner, which the old library makes, so that it is the cut list and nothing else that is red on the old library.
defect_caught: The cut list that says bodies_in_cut_list 2 of a part that has 5 bodies, and 2 rows where there are 4. The cause, measured with Checks/D9Defects (subcommand tree): the item folders of the gussets and of the end caps are Type 5 like the others but answer GetCutListType 1 (swSolidBodyCutList), and the library kept only 3 (swWeldmentCutlist). The new field item_type of every row is checked too, with the quantity of the gusset row and of the caps row, because a row of a gusset has neither a description nor a length and would be a row of nulls (review of 6/10/2026: the first version said it checked them and did not; the order of the rows, members first, is the one measured on 0.151.0).

expect.why: the short bar, 300, crossing the long one at its middle

expect.tolerance_why: 40 mm x 1469.956 mm2 of section, which has pi inside (the corner radii): the same trim as gusset_sits_in_the_corner
60 x 60 / 2 x 5, all flat: the same gusset, the same number as gusset_sits_in_the_corner

expect.why: the two bars and the gusset
end_cap on the BODY of the long bar caps its two free ends: two caps, 5 bodies in all
5 bodies in the part: two bars, one gusset, two caps. Asked of the folders, one by one, it must say the same: the old reading said 2 (the two bars)
four rows: the long bar, the short bar, the gusset, the two caps. The old reading said 2
the sum of the quantities of the rows is the number of bodies: 1 + 1 + 1 + 2
